start_here: Say to your AI: "Mark the introduction intro-1 as sent, in my shop database, with the consent I was shown." Your AI calls tool:record-an-introduction-state with the database, the id, the states and the consent, and reports the new state. Nothing is sent to anyone.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it writes the introduction_states table and its history in the database named in the input, and no list row.
instructions: 1. Name the database the state is recorded in, such as shop_for_who_runs_it. Its connection must be held in your vault under that name with -connection.
2. Say the introduction id, the state it is in now (from) and the state it moves to (to). For sent or one_yes, also give the consent and the introduction as it was shown.
3. Read the answer: id, status and says. A move the lifecycle does not allow, or an introduction that changed since it was shown, is refused and nothing is written.
4. Nothing is sent to anyone by this tool. Live sending waits for the owner's word.

worked_examples.title: Record that an introduction was sent
worked_examples.ask: Mark intro-1 as sent in my shop database, I agreed to it as shown.

shown.text: Meet for coffee about the tennis club.
